reference_set.used_for: Structural patterns only — fixed section order, two-column hero, editorial eyebrow + serif display H2s, service tiles, WhyChooseUs CSS-mask icons, UsVsThem, sub-service check bullets.

excluded_from_reference_set.reason: This is the CLIENT'S OWN existing website for this build. CLAUDE.md invariant: 'Client website is brand-only, never design DNA' — the client's site may only ever contribute fonts/colors/logo/business-context text, never layout or section rhythm, and site-audit screenshots of it are operator-reference-only. Using it as a structural/photography reference for its own redesign would violate that rule, so it was dropped from the reference set entirely rather than scraped for rhythm/photography direction.

brand_inputs.source: Firecrawl was unavailable (no FIRECRAWL_API_KEY / MCP tool configured) and the Playwright fallback could not launch (sandbox missing libatk/libgbm/libasound system libraries, no sudo to install). As a brand-only substitute (fonts/colors/logo — never layout, per the client-site-is-brand-only invariant), fetched the raw homepage HTML via curl and decoded the logo PNG's pixel data with a small inline zlib-based decoder (no Firecrawl/Playwright/PIL required).
brand_inputs.detection_notes: Red (#ff143d / logo-sampled #ff123c, effectively the same ink) is corroborated by two independent sources: a GHL page-builder custom-color swatch applied as inline-colors on page content, AND the dominant non-white pixel color in the logo PNG itself (3,524 of the top-20 sampled pixels) — high confidence this is the real brand color, not template-default noise. #101828/#667085 are a coherent text/muted gray pair used for real body copy (dialog/label text), not builder chrome. #188bf6 and #3b82f6 were excluded — grep context showed they're GoHighLevel page-builder UI chrome (drag-handle borders, sortable-ghost highlight), not site content. Outfit/Roboto came from the page's own Google Fonts @import (Outfit loaded with the full 100-900 weight range, consistent with a chosen display face; Roboto as the paired body face).

rationale.palette: Real detected brand red is #ff143d/#ff123c (see detected_colors) — but the firefly template (unlike owl) has NO --color-on-accent token: every component that fills a background with var(--color-accent) hardcodes color: white on the button text (checked Hero.astro, CTA.astro, OurServices.astro, Header.astro, Financing.astro, PricingTable.astro, CookieConsent.astro, Footer.astro), and the same var(--color-accent) is reused directly as TEXT color elsewhere (SectionHead eyebrow, ServiceAreaGrid pin, AboutSection check, FAQ chevron). One token has to satisfy both directions. White-on-#ff143d only measures 3.87:1 (fails AA 4.5:1 for normal-weight button text), and #ff143d-as-text-on-white is the same 3.87:1 by symmetry. Darkened the real red to #c81030 — same hue, deepened until white-on-fill AND fill-as-text-on-white both clear AA. accent_ink is set equal to accent since firefly has only the one accent variable, not a separate ink token. text/muted (#101828/#667085) and surface (#f5f5f5) are real values pulled from the page's own CSS, not invented.
rationale.typography: Outfit promoted to the template's display slot (replacing EB Garamond) and Roboto to body (replacing Inter) because both were confirmed as the client's actual loaded webfonts, not template placeholders.
rationale.contrast_verified: text on bg 17.75:1 (AAA), muted on bg 4.97:1 (AA), white on accent(#c81030) 5.88:1 (AA), accent(#c81030) as text on bg(#ffffff) 5.88:1 (AA), accent as text on surface(#f5f2ee) 5.27:1 (AA).

anti_patterns: purple / indigo / violet accents (unless explicitly requested)
generic construction stock photo (handshake, diverse team in hardhats)
Lucide icon rows (max 1 outline icon per section, semantic only)
"Trusted by 10,000+ customers" without a real number from GBP
randomized section order — always use the fixed order from the template
